warnings: *** SPILTER IS A TYPO ON THE DRAWING FOR SPLITTER, AND IT IS RECORDED AS PRINTED. *** §0.7 and the record-as-given rule mean the misspelling is kept verbatim in both element_id and printed_as, with the correction noted only in the description. Silently fixing it would break a match against the same sheet in the other houses of this series, which will carry the same typo.

THREE SEPARATE LEGENDS SHARE ONE VIEW because the sheet groups them under three headings on one panel - สัญลักษณ์ไฟฟ้า, สัญลักษณ์ระบบ TV and สัญลักษณ์ระบบโทรศัพท์. They are recorded in one symbol file with the system named in each description, rather than split into three files with a handful of rows each.

MOUNTING HEIGHTS ARE PART OF THE SYMBOL DEFINITIONS HERE, not of the plan: switches at 1.30 m, twin socket outlets at 0.50 m from the floor. Those are project-wide defaults carried on the legend, and E-02's plans do not repeat them, so a consumer must read them from this sheet.
This file is one of three views on หน้า24 per §3; the others are the specification notes and the LP panel diagram.
